python3 - <<'PY'
import zlib, struct, math, colorsys

# ---------- preview.png : 简单彩色图案，纯标准库 RGB ----------
W, H = 480, 320
PALETTE = [(233, 69, 96), (242, 140, 40), (247, 201, 72), (46, 176, 126),
           (56, 152, 224), (108, 99, 255), (178, 90, 214), (236, 96, 176)]

def px(x, y):
    band = min(len(PALETTE) - 1, x * len(PALETTE) // W)
    r, g, b = PALETTE[band]
    # 纵向明暗渐变
    k = 0.80 + 0.35 * (1.0 - y / (H - 1))
    # 斜向高光带
    d = abs((x * 0.55 + y) - 190)
    if d < 34:
        k += 0.30 * (1 - d / 34) ** 2
    # 中央若干同心白环
    cx, cy = W / 2, H / 2
    rr = math.hypot(x - cx, y - cy)
    if 92 < rr < 100 or 60 < rr < 65:
        k += 0.45
    r, g, b = (min(255, int(c * k)) for c in (r, g, b))
    # 4px 白色外框
    if x < 4 or y < 4 or x >= W - 4 or y >= H - 4:
        r = g = b = 250
    return bytes((r, g, b))

raw = bytearray()
for y in range(H):
    raw.append(0)                      # filter type 0
    for x in range(W):
        raw.extend(px(x, y))

def chunk(tag, data):
    return (struct.pack(">I", len(data)) + tag + data
            + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF))

png = (b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
       + chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", W, H, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
       + chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(bytes(raw), 9))
       + chunk(b"IEND", b""))
open("preview.png", "wb").write(png)
print("preview.png", len(png), "bytes")

# ---------- preview.pdf : 一页英文 ----------
TEXT = "Windows WSL PDF OK"
stream = ("BT\n/F1 28 Tf\n72 700 Td\n(%s) Tj\nET\n" % TEXT).encode("ascii")
objs = [
    b"<</Type/Catalog/Pages 2 0 R>>",
    b"<</Type/Pages/Kids [3 0 R]/Count 1>>",
    b"<</Type/Page/Parent 2 0 R/MediaBox [0 0 595 842]"
    b"/Resources <</Font <</F1 4 0 R>>>>/Contents 5 0 R>>",
    b"<</Type/Font/Subtype/Type1/BaseFont/Helvetica/Encoding/WinAnsiEncoding>>",
    b"<</Length %d>>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"endstream",
]
out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
offsets = []
for i, body in enumerate(objs, start=1):
    offsets.append(len(out))
    out += b"%d 0 obj\n" % i + body + b"\nendobj\n"
xref_at = len(out)
out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % (len(objs) + 1)
out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
for off in offsets:
    out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % off
out += b"trailer\n<</Size %d/Root 1 0 R>>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % (len(objs) + 1, xref_at)
open("preview.pdf", "wb").write(bytes(out))
print("preview.pdf", len(out), "bytes")
PY
echo '--- files ---'; ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S preview.html preview.png preview.pdf; file preview.png preview.pdf

import re, zlib, struct

print("=== PNG 结构校验 ===")
d = open("preview.png","rb").read()
assert d[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
pos, idat, hdr = 8, b"", None
while pos < len(d):
    ln, tag = struct.unpack(">I4s", d[pos:pos+8]); body = d[pos+8:pos+8+ln]
    crc = struct.unpack(">I", d[pos+8+ln:pos+12+ln])[0]
    ok = (zlib.crc32(tag+body) & 0xFFFFFFFF) == crc
    print(f"  chunk {tag.decode()} len={ln} crc_ok={ok}")
    if tag == b"IHDR": hdr = struct.unpack(">IIBBBBB", body)
    if tag == b"IDAT": idat += body
    pos += 12 + ln
w,h,bd,ct = hdr[0],hdr[1],hdr[2],hdr[3]
raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
print(f"  宽高={w}x{h} 位深={bd} 颜色类型={ct}(2=RGB) 解压后={len(raw)} 期望={h*(1+w*3)} 匹配={len(raw)==h*(1+w*3)}")
print(f"  采样像素: 左上={tuple(raw[1:4])} 中心={tuple(raw[(h//2)*(1+w*3)+1+(w//2)*3: (h//2)*(1+w*3)+4+(w//2)*3])} 右下={tuple(raw[-3:])}")

print("\n=== PDF 结构校验 ===")
p = open("preview.pdf","rb").read()
print("  header:", p[:9].decode("latin1"), "| EOF结尾:", p.rstrip().endswith(b"%%EOF"))
m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", p); sx = int(m.group(1))
print("  startxref:", sx, "-> 指向:", p[sx:sx+4].decode("latin1"))
xr = p[sx:].split(b"\n")
ents = re.findall(rb"(\d{10}) 00000 n", p[sx:])
print("  xref 条目数:", len(ents))
allok = True
for i, off in enumerate(ents, start=1):
    o = int(off); head = p[o:o+12].split(b"\n")[0]
    good = head.startswith(b"%d 0 obj" % i); allok &= good
    print(f"    obj {i} offset={o} 命中={good} 头部={head.decode('latin1')}")
print("  全部偏移正确:", allok)
print("  页数(/Count):", re.search(rb"/Count (\d+)", p).group(1).decode())
cs = re.search(rb"/Length (\d+)>>\nstream\n", p)
ln = int(cs.group(1)); st = p[cs.end():cs.end()+ln]
print("  content stream 长度自检:", len(st) == ln, "| 内容:", st.decode("latin1").replace("\n"," | "))
print("  提取文字:", re.search(rb"\((.*?)\) Tj", st).group(1).decode())
print("  页面尺寸:", re.search(rb"/MediaBox \[(.*?)\]", p).group(1).decode())
